name: Acetone   [Solvent]
Solubility: Miscible with water, ethanol, ether
Description: Acetone is a colourless, highly flammable organic solvent widely used as a cleaning agent, paint thinner, nail polish remover base, and in pharmaceutical/chemical synthesis.
Applications: Paint & coatings thinner; nail polish remover; pharmaceutical manufacturing; adhesives & resins; laboratory solvent; fibre & textile processing; FMCG personal care
Storage: Store in cool, well-ventilated area away from heat/ignition sources. Keep containers tightly closed.

name: Aluminium Sulphate   [Industrial / Water Treatment Chemical]
Solubility: 36.4 g/100 mL (20°C) in water
Description: Aluminium Sulphate is a widely-used coagulant and flocculant primarily used in water purification, paper sizing, and as a mordant in the textile/dyeing industry.
Applications: Water & effluent treatment (coagulation); paper sizing (alum); mordant in dyeing; soil acidification; fire retardant; concrete waterproofing
Storage: Store in dry conditions in sealed bags. Avoid contact with moisture and alkaline substances.

name: Caustic Soda Flakes   [Basic Industrial Chemical]
Solubility: 111 g/100 mL (20°C) in water – highly exothermic
Description: Caustic Soda Flakes (Sodium Hydroxide) is a strong alkali essential for soap/detergent manufacturing, paper & pulp, textile processing, and various chemical synthesis processes.
Applications: Soap & detergent production; textile & paper industry; water treatment pH adjustment; chemical synthesis; petroleum refining; food processing (lye)
Storage: Store in sealed, moisture-proof containers. Keep away from acids and organic materials. Highly hygroscopic.

name: Caustic Soda Prills   [Basic Industrial Chemical]
Solubility: 111 g/100 mL (20°C) in water
Description: Caustic Soda Prills are spherical beads of sodium hydroxide offering easier handling, lower dust generation, and better flow characteristics than flakes. Used in the same applications as flakes.
Applications: Soap & detergent manufacture; paper & pulp processing; textile treatment; water treatment; chemical synthesis; food grade applications
Storage: Store in dry, well-ventilated area in sealed containers. Highly hygroscopic — keep away from moisture and acids.

name: Color Speckles   [Detergent Additive]
Appearance: Coloured granular particles (blue, green, red, yellow, etc.)
Solubility: Soluble/dispersible in water
Description: Color Speckles are decorative additives incorporated at 1–3% into detergent powders to enhance visual appeal and market differentiation. They are based on sodium carbonate/SCMC matrix with inorganic dyes.
Applications: Laundry detergent powder (visual enhancement); dishwashing powder; fabric care products
Storage: Store in cool, dry place away from direct sunlight and moisture. Keep containers sealed.

name: Ethyl Acetate   [Solvent]
Solubility: 8.7 g/100 mL (20°C) in water; miscible with most organics
Description: Ethyl Acetate is a widely used, fast-evaporating, low-toxicity solvent used in paints, varnishes, inks, adhesives, and pharmaceutical extraction. It is also used as a flavouring agent.
Applications: Paints & varnishes; printing inks; adhesives; nail polish remover; pharmaceutical (extraction solvent); food flavouring; flexible packaging laminates
Storage: Store in cool, well-ventilated, flammable-safe storage away from heat and ignition sources.

name: Ferric Chloride   [Industrial / Water Treatment Chemical]
Appearance: Dark brown/orange crystalline solid or solution
Solubility: 92 g/100 mL (20°C) in water
Description: Ferric Chloride is a powerful coagulant used in water and wastewater treatment. It is also used in PCB etching, pigment production, and chemical synthesis.
Applications: Water & sewage treatment (coagulant/flocculant); PCB board etching; pigment & dye manufacturing; chemical synthesis; polymerization catalyst
Storage: Store in corrosion-resistant containers. Keep away from metals. Use acid-safe PPE when handling.

name: Glacial Acetic Acid   [Organic Acid / Solvent]
Solubility: Miscible with water in all proportions
Description: Glacial Acetic Acid is pure, undiluted acetic acid used as a raw material in vinyl acetate monomer (VAM) production, pharmaceuticals, textiles, food additives, and as a chemical reagent.
Applications: Vinyl acetate monomer production; purified terephthalic acid (PTA); food preservative (acidity regulator E260); pharmaceutical synthesis; textile dyeing (mordant); rubber coagulant
Storage: Store in cool, ventilated area. Flammable liquid — keep away from heat and oxidizing agents.

name: Glycerine (Glycerol)   [Personal Care / Food / Industrial Chemical]
Solubility: Miscible with water and alcohol; insoluble in hydrocarbons
Description: Glycerine is a naturally derived (from biodiesel/soap production) polyol used extensively as a humectant in cosmetics, pharmaceutical excipient, food additive, and in alkyd resins.
Applications: Cosmetics & personal care (humectant, skin conditioning); pharmaceutical excipients; food & beverage (sweetener, preservative); alkyd resin production; tobacco processing; nitroglycerin (explosives base)
Storage: Store in sealed containers at ambient temperature. Hygroscopic — keep away from moisture.

name: Guar Gum   [Food / Industrial Thickener / Gelling Agent]
Solubility: Dispersible/soluble in hot & cold water; insoluble in oils
Description: Guar Gum is a natural, plant-derived galactomannan polysaccharide derived from guar beans. It functions as a thickener, stabilizer, binder, and water-retention agent across food, pharma, paper, textile, and oilfield industries.
Applications: Food & beverage thickener/stabilizer; pharmaceutical binder; paper industry (wet-strength agent); textile sizing; oil & gas (fracturing fluid); cosmetics & personal care
Storage: Store in cool, dry conditions away from moisture. Avoid inhalation of powder — use mask.

name: Hydrochloric Acid   [Inorganic Acid]
Appearance: Colourless to pale yellow fuming liquid
Solubility: Fully miscible with water
Packaging: 30 L carboys / 250 L HDPE drums / ISO tanks
Description: Hydrochloric Acid (muriatic acid) is a strong mineral acid used for metal pickling, pH adjustment, leather processing, food production (lye alternative), and as a chemical intermediate.
Applications: Steel pickling & metal cleaning; pH regulation in water treatment; leather processing; food-grade HCl (E507) for gelatin/corn processing; PVC production; oil well acidizing
Storage: Store in acid-resistant, sealed containers in ventilated area. Never mix with alkalis or oxidizers.

name: Hydrogen Peroxide   [Oxidizing Agent / Bleaching Agent]
Appearance: Colourless, clear liquid (slightly more viscous than water)
Solubility: Miscible with water
Description: Hydrogen Peroxide is a versatile oxidant and bleaching agent used for textile bleaching, paper pulp bleaching, water treatment, disinfection, and as an environmentally friendly oxidizer.
Applications: Textile & fabric bleaching; pulp/paper bleaching; wastewater treatment (oxidation); disinfection & sterilization; electronics etching; cosmetics (hair bleaching)
Storage: Store in cool, dark, ventilated area in original containers. Keep away from organics, metals, and flammables. Strong oxidizer.

name: ISO Propyl Alcohol (IPA)   [Solvent / Disinfectant]
Solubility: Miscible with water, alcohol, ether, acetone
Description: Isopropyl Alcohol (IPA) is a versatile solvent and disinfectant used in pharmaceuticals, cosmetics, electronics cleaning, hand sanitizers, and as a laboratory reagent.
Applications: Hand sanitizers & disinfectants (70% solution); pharmaceutical manufacturing; electronics & PCB cleaning; cosmetics (astringent, solvent); printing inks; fuel additive
Storage: Highly flammable. Store in cool, ventilated, explosion-proof storage away from heat and ignition sources.

name: LABSA (Linear Alkylbenzene Sulphonic Acid)   [Surfactant / Detergent Raw Material]
Solubility: Dispersible in water; soluble in organic solvents
Description: LABSA is the most widely used anionic surfactant and key raw material in the manufacture of household and industrial detergents, liquid soaps, and cleaning products. It is neutralized with NaOH to produce the sodium salt (LAS).
Applications: Detergent powder & liquid manufacturing; liquid dish soap; laundry liquids; hard surface cleaners; emulsifiers; textile auxiliaries
Storage: Store in HDPE or SS containers at 10–30°C. Avoid contact with alkalis. Keep containers sealed.

name: Liquid Chlorine   [Halogen / Disinfectant / Chemical Intermediate]
Solubility: 7.2 g/L (20°C) in water
Description: Liquid Chlorine is a compressed liquefied halogen gas used as a powerful disinfectant for water treatment, bleaching agent for paper/textiles, and chemical intermediate for PVC, solvents, and agrochemicals.
Applications: Water & swimming pool disinfection; paper & pulp bleaching; textile bleaching; PVC/chlorinated solvent manufacture; pharmaceutical synthesis; agrochemical production
Storage: Store in pressurized cylinders in cool, well-ventilated cage away from organic materials. Handle with full protective equipment.

name: Methoxy Propanol (1-Methoxy-2-Propanol)   [Glycol Ether Solvent]
Solubility: Miscible with water and most organic solvents
Description: Methoxy Propanol (PM Solvent) is a slow-evaporating, water-miscible glycol ether solvent with excellent coupling properties, widely used in paints, coatings, cleaners, and inks.
Applications: Waterborne & solventborne paints and coatings; printing inks; cleaning agents; adhesives; wood coatings; electronics cleaning
Storage: Flammable. Store in sealed containers in cool, well-ventilated area away from heat and oxidizers.

name: N-Propanol (1-Propanol)   [Alcohol Solvent]
Solubility: Miscible with water, alcohols, ethers, ketones
Description: N-Propanol is a straight-chain primary alcohol used as a solvent in coatings, printing inks, and cosmetics, and as an intermediate in ester and ether synthesis.
Applications: Flexographic & gravure printing inks; surface coatings; cosmetics & toiletries; cleaning agents; pharmaceutical synthesis; intermediate for propyl esters
Storage: Highly flammable. Store in sealed containers away from heat, sparks, and ignition sources.

name: N-Propyl Acetate   [Ester Solvent]
Solubility: Partially miscible with water (18.9 g/L); miscible with organic solvents
Description: N-Propyl Acetate is a fast-evaporating ester solvent with a pleasant fruity odour, preferred in high-end wood coatings, flexographic printing inks, and automotive refinish applications.
Applications: Wood coatings & lacquers; automotive refinish coatings; printing inks; adhesives; nail polish formulations; fragrance solvent
Storage: Highly flammable. Store in cool, well-ventilated area away from heat and ignition sources.

name: Nitric Acid   [Strong Inorganic Acid / Oxidizer]
Appearance: Colourless to pale yellow fuming liquid
Solubility: Miscible with water
Description: Nitric Acid is a powerful strong mineral acid and oxidizing agent used in fertilizer production, explosives manufacturing, metal treatment, electroplating, and chemical synthesis.
Applications: Ammonium nitrate (fertilizer) production; explosives (TNT, nitroglycerin); metal pickling & etching; electroplating; semiconductor manufacturing; organic synthesis (nitration)
Storage: Store in corrosion-resistant, acid-safe containers. Strong oxidizer — keep away from organic materials, metals, and flammables.

name: Poly Aluminium Chloride (PAC)   [Water Treatment Chemical / Coagulant]
Appearance: Yellow to brown powder or liquid
Solubility: Readily soluble in water
Description: Poly Aluminium Chloride (PAC) is an inorganic polymer coagulant used in water purification, paper sizing, and wastewater treatment. It works more efficiently than alum at lower dosages and over a wider pH range.
Applications: Drinking water clarification; sewage & industrial effluent treatment; paper sizing (wet-end); textile dye removal; sludge dewatering
Storage: Store in sealed containers in dry area. Liquid PAC should not be allowed to freeze. Keep away from strong alkalis.

name: Potassium Hydroxide (KOH)   [Strong Alkali / Industrial Chemical]
Solubility: 121 g/100 mL (25°C) in water – highly exothermic
Description: Potassium Hydroxide (caustic potash) is a strong alkali used in soft soap making (potassium soaps), biodiesel production, alkaline batteries, pharmaceuticals, and fertilizers.
Applications: Soft/liquid soap production; biodiesel glycerolysis; alkaline batteries; potassium salt synthesis; pharmaceutical formulations; food processing; fertilizer (potassium source)
Storage: Store in moisture-proof, sealed containers. Highly hygroscopic. Keep away from acids and organic matter.

name: SCMC (Sodium Carboxy Methyl Cellulose)   [Detergent Additive / Thickener / Binder]
Solubility: Dispersible/soluble in hot and cold water; insoluble in organic solvents
Purity / Grade: Degree of substitution (DS): 0.65–0.85 (detergent grade); viscosity per grade specification
Description: Sodium Carboxymethyl Cellulose (SCMC / CMC) is a cellulose-derived water-soluble polymer used as an anti-redeposition agent in detergents, thickener in food, binder in pharmaceuticals, and rheology modifier in drilling fluids.
Applications: Laundry detergent (anti-soil redeposition agent); food additive (E466, thickener/stabilizer); pharmaceutical tablet binder; paper coating; oil drilling mud additive; textile sizing
Storage: Store in cool, dry area. Hygroscopic — keep sealed to prevent moisture absorption.

name: SLS (Sodium Lauryl Sulphate)   [Anionic Surfactant / Detergent Raw Material]
Solubility: Freely soluble in water; insoluble in non-polar solvents
Description: SLS (Sodium Lauryl Sulphate) is a primary anionic surfactant with excellent foaming and cleansing properties, widely used in personal care products, toothpaste, shampoos, and industrial detergents.
Applications: Shampoos & hair care products; toothpaste & dental care; liquid soap & body wash; industrial detergents; emulsion polymerization; pharmaceutical (wetting agent)
Storage: Store in cool, dry area in sealed containers. Avoid high temperatures which may cause caking.

name: SLES (Sodium Lauryl Ether Sulphate)   [Mild Anionic Surfactant / Detergent Raw Material]
Appearance: Colourless to pale yellow viscous liquid (28–70%)
Solubility: Miscible with water
Description: SLES (Sodium Lauryl Ether Sulphate) is a mild anionic surfactant derived from SLS via ethoxylation, making it gentler on skin. It is one of the most used surfactants globally in personal care and home care formulations.
Applications: Shampoos; liquid soaps & body wash; bubble bath; liquid dishwashing detergents; laundry liquids; cosmetic formulations; industrial cleaning
Storage: Store at 5–35°C in sealed containers. May become viscous at low temperatures but is reversible on warming.

name: Soda Ash Light (Sodium Carbonate)   [Alkali / Industrial Chemical]
Solubility: 22 g/100 mL (20°C) in water
Description: Soda Ash Light is the light-density form of sodium carbonate, an essential industrial chemical used in glass manufacturing, detergent formulation, water softening, and as a pH buffer.
Applications: Glass manufacturing; detergent powder filler/builder (alkalinity source); water softening; pH adjustment; textile scouring; paper & pulp processing; baking (food grade)
Storage: Store in dry, sealed conditions. Hygroscopic — prolonged moisture exposure causes agglomeration.

name: Sodium Bicarbonate   [Food / Industrial Chemical]
Solubility: 9.6 g/100 mL (20°C) in water
Description: Sodium Bicarbonate (baking soda) is a mild alkali used as a leavening agent in food, antacid in pharmaceuticals, fire extinguishant, deodorizer, and pH buffer in various industrial applications.
Applications: Baking (leavening agent); pharmaceutical antacids; fire suppression; water treatment pH adjustment; animal feed supplement; cleaning & deodorizing; flue gas desulphurization
Storage: Store in cool, dry area away from heat and acids. Decomposition above 50°C releases CO₂.

name: Sodium Silicate (Water Glass)   [Binder / Adhesive / Industrial Chemical]
Appearance: Colourless to light amber viscous liquid
Solubility: Fully miscible with water
Description: Sodium Silicate (Water Glass) is an inorganic adhesive, binder, and sealing agent used in detergents (corrosion inhibitor for washing machines), refractories, paper, textile, and as a concrete hardener.
Applications: Detergent additive (metal corrosion inhibitor, alkalinity buffer); refractory cements; cardboard/paper bonding; textile processing; silica gel production; concrete densifier/hardener
Storage: Store in sealed containers at ambient temperature. Avoid freezing. Alkaline — avoid contact with skin/eyes.

name: Sodium Sulphate Anhydrous   [Industrial Chemical / Detergent Filler]
Solubility: 28.1 g/100 mL (30°C) in water
Description: Sodium Sulphate Anhydrous (Glauber's Salt, dried) is a key filler and diluent in spray-dried detergent powders. It is also used in glass manufacturing, Kraft pulp process, and as a drying agent.
Applications: Detergent powder filler/carrier; glass manufacturing (sodium source); Kraft pulping process; textile dyeing (levelling agent); drying agent in organic chemistry; starch & glucose processing
Storage: Store in dry, sealed bags away from moisture. Non-hazardous under normal conditions.

name: Sorbitol   [Food / Cosmetic / Pharmaceutical Ingredient]
Appearance: Clear, colourless to slightly yellow viscous liquid (70%) or white crystalline powder
Solubility: Miscible with water; slightly soluble in ethanol
Description: Sorbitol is a sugar alcohol used as a humectant, sweetener, and bulking agent in food, personal care products, and pharmaceutical formulations. It is also used as a softening agent in toothpaste and diabetic-friendly foods.
Applications: Toothpaste humectant & texturizer; sugar-free food sweetener; pharmaceutical excipient (syrup base); cosmetics moisturizer; vitamin C (ascorbic acid) production intermediate; plasticizer for resins
Storage: Store at 10–30°C in sealed containers. Liquid grade may crystallize at low temperatures — warm gently to redissolve.

name: Sulphuric Acid   [Strong Inorganic Acid]
Appearance: Colourless to slightly yellow oily liquid
Solubility: Miscible with water (highly exothermic — always add acid to water)
Packaging: 35 kg carboys / 250 L acid-safe drums / ISO tanks
Description: Sulphuric Acid is the world's most produced industrial chemical, used in fertilizer production (superphosphate, ammonium sulphate), LABSA sulphonation, battery acid, metal processing, and chemical synthesis.
Applications: Fertilizer manufacture (superphosphate, ammonium sulphate); LABSA/surfactant sulphonation; lead-acid battery electrolyte; metal pickling & cleaning; petroleum refining; dyestuff manufacture
Storage: Store in acid-resistant containers (HDPE, SS 316L). Always add acid to water — never reverse. Highly corrosive and exothermic.

name: Toluene   [Aromatic Hydrocarbon Solvent]
Solubility: 0.52 g/L (25°C) in water; miscible with most organics
Description: Toluene is an important aromatic solvent and chemical intermediate used in paints, adhesives, printing inks, pharmaceutical synthesis, and as a raw material for TNT, benzene (dealkylation), and toluene diisocyanate (TDI).
Applications: Paints, coatings & lacquers; adhesives & sealants; printing inks; pharmaceutical synthesis; TDI (polyurethane) production; rubber cement; gasoline octane booster
Storage: Highly flammable. Store in sealed containers in flammable-safe storage away from heat, sparks, and ignition sources.

name: Xylene (Mixed Xylenes)   [Aromatic Hydrocarbon Solvent]
Solubility: Practically insoluble in water; miscible with organics
Description: Xylene (mixed o/m/p isomers) is a high-boiling aromatic solvent widely used in paints, lacquers, printing inks, adhesives, and as a diluent for alkyd resins. It is also a feedstock for PTA (purified terephthalic acid) production.
Applications: Paints, lacquers & varnishes; printing inks; adhesives; rubber cement; laboratory solvent; PTA (polyester) feedstock; cleaning & degreasing
Storage: Flammable. Store in sealed containers in well-ventilated, flammable-safe storage. Vapor heavier than air — ensure adequate ventilation.

name: ZEOLITE 4A   [Detergent Builder / Water Softener]
Solubility: Insoluble in water (dispersible); ion-exchange in aqueous media
Purity / Grade: ≥80% zeolite content; calcium binding capacity ≥155 mg CaCO₃/g
Description: Zeolite 4A (Sodium Aluminosilicate) is a synthetic zeolite used as a phosphate-free detergent builder for water softening by calcium/magnesium ion exchange. It replaces STPP in environmentally-friendly detergent formulations.
Applications: Laundry detergent builder (water softener, phosphate-free); liquid carrier for surfactants in powder detergents; desiccant; cat litter additive; animal feed additive
Storage: Store in sealed bags in dry area. Prevent moisture absorption. Non-hazardous under normal handling conditions.

name: Zinc Oxide   [Industrial / Cosmetic / Rubber Chemical]
Solubility: Insoluble in water; soluble in acids and alkalis
Description: Zinc Oxide is a versatile white pigment and chemical used as a UV absorber in sunscreens, vulcanization activator in rubber, semiconductor material, and as an antimicrobial agent in personal care products.
Applications: Rubber vulcanization (activator); sunscreen & cosmetics (UV filter); paints & coatings (white pigment, mold inhibitor); pharmaceuticals (antiseptic, wound care); animal feed supplement; ceramic glazes
Storage: Store in sealed bags in cool, dry area. Avoid inhalation of dust. Non-toxic but inhalation of fine particles should be avoided.

name: Pine Oil   [Natural Solvent / Disinfectant]
Solubility: Partially soluble in water; miscible with alcohols
Description: Pine Oil is a natural terpene-based solvent and disinfectant derived from pine wood pulp. It is widely used as a fragrance component, cleaning agent, flotation reagent in mining, and antimicrobial in household cleaners.
Applications: Disinfectant & cleaning agents; flotation agent in mineral processing; fragrance in floor cleaners; textile scouring; printing ink solvent; adhesives
Storage: Store in cool, well-ventilated area away from heat. Keep containers sealed.

name: Dibutyl Phthalate (MAXFLEX 400 P N)   [Plasticizer]
Solubility: Insoluble in water; miscible with organic solvents
Description: Dibutyl Phthalate (DBP) is a primary plasticizer for PVC and cellulosic polymers, providing flexibility and workability. It is also used as a solvent for dyes, adhesives, and printing inks.
Applications: PVC plasticizer; cellulose acetate plasticizer; adhesives & sealants; nitrocellulose lacquers; pesticide carrier; cosmetic nail polish (legacy use)
Storage: Store in sealed containers in cool, well-ventilated area. Avoid prolonged skin contact.

name: Di Iso Butyl Phthalate (MAXFLEX 400 P I)   [Plasticizer]
Solubility: Insoluble in water; miscible with organics
Description: Di-Isobutyl Phthalate (DIBP) is a plasticizer used as an alternative to DBP, offering similar compatibility with PVC and cellulose derivatives, with slightly better low-temperature performance.
Applications: PVC & cellulose resin plasticizer; adhesives; nitrocellulose coatings; paper & leather coatings; printing inks
Storage: Store in sealed containers in cool, ventilated area. Avoid ignition sources.

name: Chlorinated Paraffin (MAXCHLOR)   [Flame Retardant / Plasticizer]
Appearance: Light yellow to amber viscous liquid
Solubility: Insoluble in water; soluble in hydrocarbons and chlorinated solvents
Description: Chlorinated Paraffins are used as secondary plasticizers, extreme-pressure lubricant additives, and flame retardants in PVC, rubber, and metalworking fluids.
Applications: PVC secondary plasticizer; flame retardant in cables & plastics; metalworking cutting fluids; rubber compounds; sealants & adhesives
Storage: Store in sealed containers. Avoid exposure to strong acids and high temperatures.

name: Di Butyl Maleate (MAXFLEX 400 M)   [Reactive Plasticizer / Monomer]
Solubility: Insoluble in water; miscible with organic solvents
Description: Di Butyl Maleate (DBM) is a reactive plasticizer and co-monomer used in polymer synthesis, especially for acrylic and PVC-based systems, improving flexibility and compatibility.
Applications: PVC internal plasticizer; co-monomer in acrylic polymers; adhesives; UV-curable coatings; release coatings
Storage: Store away from heat and oxidizing agents. Mild skin irritant — use PPE.

name: Lead Oxide   [PVC Stabilizer / Industrial Chemical]
Solubility: Insoluble in water; soluble in acids and alkalis
Description: Lead Oxide (litharge/minium) is used as a heat and light stabilizer in PVC compounds, as a pigment, and in the manufacture of glass, ceramics, and lead batteries.
Applications: PVC heat stabilizer (legacy); glass & ceramic colorant; lead-acid battery plates; rust-inhibiting primers; soldering fluxes
Storage: Toxic heavy metal compound — handle with full PPE. Store in sealed containers away from food sources. Follow local regulations.

name: Tribasic Lead Sulphate   [PVC Stabilizer]
Solubility: Insoluble in water
Description: Tribasic Lead Sulphate is a traditional heat stabilizer and light stabilizer for rigid PVC applications, providing excellent long-term thermal stability in pipes, profiles, and wire insulation.
Applications: Rigid PVC heat stabilizer; PVC pipes, profiles & cables; flexible PVC compounds
Storage: Lead compound — hazardous. Use full PPE. Store sealed away from food. Comply with local lead handling regulations.

name: Dibasic Lead Phosphate   [PVC Stabilizer / Lubricant]
Solubility: Insoluble in water
Description: Dibasic Lead Phosphate (DBLP) is a PVC heat and light stabilizer with combined lubricating properties, used in rigid and semi-rigid PVC formulations.
Applications: PVC heat & light stabilizer; rigid PVC pipes, profiles, cables; internal lubricant in PVC compounds
Storage: Lead compound — toxic. Full PPE required. Store sealed, away from food. Comply with regulations.

name: One Pack Stabilizer   [PVC Stabilizer System]
Appearance: White to off-white powder or granules
Solubility: Insoluble in water
Description: One-Pack Stabilizer systems are pre-blended PVC thermal stabilizer packages combining heat stabilizers, lubricants, and process aids in a single additive for ease of use in rigid PVC applications.
Applications: Rigid PVC pipes, profiles, fittings; window frames; cable compounds; foam PVC sheets
Storage: Store in dry, sealed containers at ambient temperature. Avoid humidity.

name: Liquid Stabilizer   [PVC Liquid Stabilizer]
Solubility: Insoluble in water; compatible with PVC/plasticizer systems
Description: Liquid PVC Stabilizer (typically Ba/Zn or Ca/Zn systems) provides heat and light stability in flexible PVC applications and is easy to incorporate in paste/calendering processes.
Applications: Flexible PVC flooring, wall coverings; PVC plastisols; artificial leather; cables; film & sheet
Storage: Store sealed in cool, dry area. Avoid contamination with water. Follow SDS for specific product.

name: Antistatic Agent   [Polymer Additive]
Chemical Formula: Proprietary (quaternary ammonium salt / glycerol monostearate based)
Appearance: White to off-white solid or liquid
Solubility: Partially soluble/dispersible in water; compatible with polymers
Description: Antistatic Agents are additives incorporated into plastics (PE, PP, PVC) to reduce static charge build-up, preventing dust attraction, packaging cling, and electrostatic hazards.
Applications: Polyolefin & PVC antistatic additive; packaging films; agricultural films; electronic component packaging; flooring
Storage: Store in cool, dry, sealed conditions. Solid grades: protect from moisture.

name: Tin Stabilizer   [PVC Stabilizer (High Performance)]
Solubility: Insoluble in water; compatible with PVC
Description: Organotin (dibutyltin/dioctyltin) stabilizers are high-performance PVC thermal stabilizers offering exceptional clarity, weatherability, and heat resistance — the preferred stabilizer for transparent and food-contact PVC.
Applications: Transparent rigid PVC (bottles, blister packs); food-contact PVC (dioctyltin grade); PVC window profiles; rigid pipes; film and sheet
Storage: Store in sealed containers. Organotin compounds are toxic — use full PPE. Follow local regulations.

name: Zinc Stearate   [Lubricant / Stabilizer / Release Agent]
Solubility: Insoluble in water; soluble in hot aromatic solvents
Description: Zinc Stearate is a metallic soap used as an internal/external lubricant, mold release agent, and co-stabilizer in PVC and rubber processing. Also used as a flatting agent in paints.
Applications: PVC lubricant & co-stabilizer; rubber processing lubricant; mold release agent; paint matting/flatting agent; cosmetics (face powder); paper coating
Storage: Store in cool, dry area in sealed bags. Avoid moisture absorption.

name: Calcium Stearate   [PVC Lubricant / Stabilizer / Food Additive]
Solubility: Insoluble in water
Description: Calcium Stearate is a versatile metallic soap used as PVC lubricant and co-stabilizer, anti-caking agent in food/pharma, mold release agent in rubber, and surface coating for paper.
Applications: PVC lubricant & co-stabilizer; food anti-caking agent (E470); pharmaceutical tablet lubricant; rubber processing aid; paper & board coating; cosmetics
Storage: Store in sealed bags in dry, cool conditions. Non-hazardous under normal handling.

name: Cocamido propyl Betaine (BETAINEMAX)   [Amphoteric Surfactant]
Appearance: Clear to slightly hazy amber liquid (30–35% solution)
Solubility: Miscible with water
Description: Cocamidopropyl Betaine (CAPB) is a mild amphoteric surfactant derived from coconut oil. It is widely used as a foam booster, viscosity builder, and mildness enhancer in personal care and home care products, compatible with both anionic and cationic surfactants.
Applications: Shampoos & hair conditioners; liquid soaps & body wash; baby care products; facial cleansers; bubble baths; mild dishwashing liquids; industrial cleaning
Storage: Store at 10–35°C in sealed containers. May become hazy at low temperatures — reversible on warming.

name: Alkyl Polyglucoside (GLUCOMAX)   [Non-ionic / Green Surfactant]
Appearance: Clear to slightly yellow viscous liquid
Solubility: Fully miscible with water
Description: Alkyl Polyglucosides (APG) are naturally derived, biodegradable non-ionic surfactants produced from glucose and fatty alcohols. They are mild, skin-compatible, and highly effective across a wide pH range.
Applications: Mild shampoos & skin cleansers; baby products; household cleaners; dish detergents; industrial & institutional cleaners; agricultural formulations (adjuvants)
Storage: Store in sealed containers at 15–35°C. Avoid freezing. Keep away from strong acids.

name: Zinc Sulphate   [Micronutrient / Industrial Chemical]
Appearance: White crystalline powder (monohydrate) or colorless crystals (heptahydrate)
Solubility: 57.7 g/100 mL (20°C) in water
Description: Zinc Sulphate is a key zinc micronutrient for agriculture, used in foliar sprays and soil application for zinc-deficient crops. Also used in animal feed, water treatment, and electroplating.
Applications: Agricultural micronutrient (zinc fertilizer); animal feed supplement; water treatment (algicide); electroplating; rayon fiber production; zinc-based chemicals
Storage: Store in sealed bags away from moisture. Non-hazardous under normal conditions.

name: Manganese Sulphate   [Micronutrient / Industrial Chemical]
Appearance: Pale pink to white crystalline powder
Solubility: 63 g/100 mL (20°C) in water
Description: Manganese Sulphate Monohydrate is an essential manganese micronutrient for crops and animal feed. It is also used as a catalyst, in electroplating, and in the manufacture of dry cell batteries.
Applications: Crop micronutrient fertilizer; animal feed additive; dry cell batteries (MnO₂ production); electroplating; paint drier; fungicide
Storage: Store in sealed bags in dry conditions. Non-hazardous under standard handling.

name: Precipitated Silica   [Reinforcing Filler / Carrier / Adsorbent]
Solubility: Insoluble in water; soluble in HF and strong alkali
Description: Precipitated Silica is an amorphous, white, porous silica powder produced by chemical precipitation. It is the key reinforcing agent in green tyre rubber, and also used as an adsorbent, anti-caking agent, and thickener.
Applications: Green tyre & rubber reinforcing filler; toothpaste (abrasive & thickener); anti-caking agent in food & feed; paint flatting/matting agent; silica gel/desiccant carrier; beer clarifier
Storage: Store in sealed bags in dry, cool conditions. Avoid inhalation of fine dust — use respiratory protection.

name: Polyglycerol Ester   [Emulsifier / Food Additive]
Appearance: Light yellow to amber viscous liquid or soft solid
Solubility: Dispersible/emulsifiable in water; soluble in fats and oils
Description: Polyglycerol Esters (PGE) are non-ionic emulsifiers used in food, cosmetics, and industrial applications. They improve aeration, texture, shelf life, and emulsification in bakery, dairy, and confectionery products.
Applications: Food emulsifier (E475/E476) in bakery, margarine, chocolate; cosmetic emulsifier; non-dairy creamer; crystal modifier in fats; personal care formulations
Storage: Store in sealed containers at cool, dry conditions. Solid grades should be protected from moisture.

name: Sorbitan Monostearate   [Non-ionic Emulsifier (Span 60)]
Solubility: Dispersible in warm water; soluble in most organic solvents
Description: Sorbitan Monostearate (Span 60) is a lipophilic non-ionic emulsifier used in food, pharmaceuticals, and cosmetics as a W/O emulsifier, crystal modifier, and stabilizer.
Applications: Food W/O emulsifier (E491); pharmaceutical emulsifier; cosmetic cream formulations; confectionery (chocolate bloom inhibitor); yeast rehydration agent
Storage: Store below 30°C away from moisture. Protect from direct sunlight.

name: Sorbitan Monooleate   [Non-ionic Emulsifier (Span 80)]
Solubility: Dispersible in warm water; soluble in oils and organics
Description: Sorbitan Monooleate (Span 80) is a highly lipophilic emulsifier used in W/O emulsions, agrochemical formulations, and industrial applications as a wetting and dispersing agent.
Applications: W/O emulsifier in cosmetics & topical pharmaceuticals; agricultural emulsifiable concentrates; metalworking fluids; leather processing; corrosion inhibitor formulations
Storage: Store in sealed drums away from heat sources. Liquid at room temperature.

name: Sorbitan Tristearate   [Non-ionic Emulsifier (Span 65)]
Solubility: Dispersible in warm water; soluble in oils
Description: Sorbitan Tristearate (Span 65) is a highly lipophilic emulsifier and crystal modifier used to control polymorphism in chocolate and confectionery and as a W/O emulsifier.
Applications: Chocolate & confectionery crystal modifier (bloom inhibitor); W/O emulsifier; cosmetic formulations; polishes and coatings
Storage: Store in sealed containers below 30°C in dry conditions.

name: VAM-VeoVa (Vinyl Acetate Monomer / Vinyl Ester of Versatic Acid)   [Emulsion Polymer Monomer]
Chemical Formula: CH₃COOCH=CH₂ / vinyl ester of C10 acid
Solubility: Partially soluble in water (2%); miscible with organics
Description: VAM-VeoVa copolymer emulsions are the basis for exterior architectural coatings, woodworking adhesives, and construction materials. They offer excellent weatherability and adhesion.
Applications: Exterior architectural emulsion paints; woodworking adhesives; construction emulsions; cement modifiers; non-woven fabric binders
Storage: VAM: highly flammable — store in cool, explosion-proof storage. VeoVa: store in sealed containers away from heat.

name: Poly Vinyl Acetate Homopolymer   [Adhesive Polymer Emulsion]
Appearance: White milky to slightly yellowish emulsion
Solubility: Emulsion form — dispersible; dried film water-resistant
Description: Polyvinyl Acetate (PVAc) Homopolymer emulsion is the classic wood adhesive (PVA glue), used in woodworking, paper lamination, bookbinding, and packaging applications.
Applications: Woodworking adhesive (PVA glue); paper lamination; bookbinding; packaging adhesives; school/craft glue; construction adhesive
Storage: Store at 5–30°C. Protect from freezing and direct sunlight. Keep containers tightly sealed.

name: Pure Acrylic Emulsion   [Paint / Coating Binder]
Solubility: Emulsion form — water-based; dried film water-resistant
Description: Pure Acrylic Emulsions are high-quality binder resins for exterior and interior architectural paints, providing excellent weatherability, UV resistance, gloss retention, and colour stability.
Applications: Premium exterior & interior wall paints; roof coatings; wood coatings; elastomeric coatings; primers
Storage: Store at 5–35°C. Protect from freezing. Keep sealed — skin formation on exposure.

name: Acrylic Styrene Emulsion   [Paint / Coating Binder]
Solubility: Emulsion form — water-based
Description: Styrene-Acrylic copolymer emulsions are cost-effective binders for interior and exterior paints, paper coatings, and adhesives. They offer good hardness, water resistance, and blocking resistance.
Applications: Interior & exterior wall emulsion paints; paper coating; construction materials; adhesives; textile finishing
Storage: Store at 5–35°C. Do not freeze. Keep sealed. pH sensitive — avoid acidic contamination.

name: Phenalkamine Hardeners (MAXAMINE)   [Epoxy Curing Agent / Hardener]
Appearance: Dark amber to brown viscous liquid
Solubility: Insoluble in water; soluble in organic solvents and epoxy resins
Description: Phenalkamine (Cardanol-based) hardeners are bio-based epoxy curing agents offering excellent moisture tolerance, chemical resistance, and flexibility. They are ideal for marine coatings, concrete protection, and adhesives in humid conditions.
Applications: Marine & protective coatings; floor coatings; concrete coatings; adhesives; fast-cure systems; underwater coatings
Storage: Store in sealed containers away from moisture and moisture-sensitive epoxy resins. Use PPE.

name: Polyamide Hardeners (MAXAMIDE)   [Epoxy Curing Agent / Hardener]
Appearance: Light yellow to amber viscous liquid
Solubility: Insoluble in water; compatible with epoxy resins
Description: Polyamide hardeners, derived from dimerized fatty acids and polyamines, are widely used epoxy curing agents known for excellent adhesion, flexibility, and moisture tolerance at ambient temperatures.
Applications: General-purpose epoxy coatings; floor coatings; marine coatings; primers; adhesives; potting compounds
Storage: Store in sealed containers. Hygroscopic — protect from moisture. Handle with gloves and eye protection.

name: Epoxy Resin (EPOMAX)   [Thermoset Resin]
Appearance: Clear to slightly yellow viscous liquid (liquid grades) or solid (solid grades)
Melting Point: Varies (liquid at RT for standard grades)
Solubility: Insoluble in water; soluble in ketones and esters
Description: Liquid Bisphenol A Epoxy Resins are the most widely used thermoset resins, offering outstanding chemical resistance, adhesion, and mechanical strength when cured with polyamine, polyamide, or anhydride hardeners.
Applications: Protective & marine coatings; adhesives; electrical encapsulation & PCB laminates; flooring systems; civil engineering composites; automotive coatings
Storage: Store in sealed containers below 30°C. Keep away from curing agents until use. Long shelf life if stored correctly.

name: Phenoxyethanol   [Preservative / Cosmetic Ingredient]
Solubility: 2.67 g/100 mL (20°C) in water; miscible with ethanol and ether
Description: Phenoxyethanol is a broad-spectrum preservative used in cosmetics and personal care products as an alternative to parabens, offering activity against bacteria and yeast at low concentrations (≤1%).
Applications: Cosmetic preservative (shampoo, lotion, cream); pharmaceutical preservative; vaccine adjuvant; industrial antimicrobial; perfume fixative
Storage: Store in sealed containers at ambient temperature. Avoid prolonged skin contact.

name: Chlorhexidine Gluconate (MAXICIDE)   [Broad-spectrum Antimicrobial / Disinfectant]
Appearance: Clear, colourless to pale yellow aqueous solution
Solubility: Soluble in water and ethanol
Description: Chlorhexidine Gluconate (CHG) is a potent antimicrobial agent active against gram-positive and gram-negative bacteria, yeasts, and some viruses. It is widely used as a surgical scrub, wound antiseptic, and veterinary disinfectant.
Applications: Surgical hand scrub & skin antiseptic; wound disinfectant; mouthwash (dental care); veterinary disinfectant; pharmaceutical preservative; food industry hygiene
Storage: Store at 15–30°C in sealed containers away from light. Incompatible with anionic surfactants and chlorine-containing compounds.

name: Monochloro Acetic Acid (MCAA)   [Chemical Intermediate]
Appearance: White to off-white crystalline solid (or liquid above 63°C)
Solubility: Freely soluble in water (85.5 g/100 mL at 25°C)
Description: Monochloroacetic Acid (MCAA) is a highly reactive chemical intermediate used in the synthesis of CMC/SCMC, herbicides (glycine, 2,4-D, MCPA), and surfactants.
Applications: SCMC/CMC production (carboxymethylation of cellulose); herbicide synthesis (glyphosate, 2,4-D); surfactant synthesis; dye intermediates; pharmaceutical synthesis
Storage: Corrosive — store in sealed containers away from moisture and alkalis. Full PPE required. Very toxic — handle with extreme care.

name: Sodium Monochloro Acetate (SMCA)   [Chemical Intermediate]
Solubility: Freely soluble in water
Description: Sodium Monochloroacetate (SMCA) is the sodium salt of MCAA, used as a safer-handling alternative for MCAA in the synthesis of CMC, thioglycolic acid, and other industrial chemicals.
Applications: CMC/SCMC production; herbicide synthesis; thioglycolic acid production; surfactant synthesis; pharmaceutical intermediates
Storage: Store in dry, sealed containers. Avoid contact with strong acids, which regenerate free MCAA. Use PPE.

name: Dimethyl Amino Propyl Amine (DMAPA)   [Amine / Chemical Intermediate]
Solubility: Miscible with water, alcohols, and most organic solvents
Description: DMAPA (3-(Dimethylamino)-1-propylamine) is a key intermediate for the synthesis of CAPB (cocamidopropyl betaine), amphoacetates, and other amphoteric surfactants used in personal care.
Applications: CAPB synthesis (betaine surfactants); amphoacetate synthesis; cationic biocides synthesis; epoxy curing agent; textile softener; corrosion inhibitor
Storage: Flammable and corrosive — store in sealed containers away from heat and oxidizers. Strong amine — full PPE required.

name: Benzyl Alcohol   [Solvent / Preservative / Fragrance Ingredient]
Solubility: 4% v/v in water; miscible with alcohols and organic solvents
Description: Benzyl Alcohol is a versatile aromatic solvent and fragrance ingredient used as a preservative in cosmetics and pharmaceuticals, an ink and resin solvent, and in flavour/fragrance synthesis.
Applications: Cosmetic preservative (paraben alternative); pharmaceutical solvent/preservative; fragrance ingredient; paint & varnish solvent; ink & resin solvent; plasticizer intermediate
Storage: Store in sealed containers at ambient temperature. Combustible — keep away from ignition sources.

name: Benzyl Chloride   [Chemical Intermediate / Chlorinating Agent]
Solubility: Insoluble in water; miscible with organic solvents
Packaging: 200 kg drums (stainless steel or HDPE lined)
Description: Benzyl Chloride is an important chemical intermediate for the synthesis of benzyl compounds including benzyl alcohol, benzaldehyde, benzalkonium chloride, and quaternary ammonium compounds.
Applications: Benzyl compound synthesis; BKC/QAC synthesis; perfume & fragrance intermediates; pharmaceutical synthesis; dye intermediates; resin modifier
Storage: Lachrymatory — highly irritating vapour. Store in sealed containers in cool, ventilated area with corrosion-resistant lining. Full PPE essential.

name: Castor Oil Ethoxylates   [Non-ionic Emulsifier / Solubilizer]
Appearance: Clear to slightly yellow viscous liquid
Solubility: Soluble/dispersible in water (higher EO content more hydrophilic)
Description: Castor Oil Ethoxylates are non-ionic surfactants derived from the ethoxylation of castor oil. They function as emulsifiers, solubilizers, and wetting agents, and are widely used to formulate fragrances and essential oils into aqueous systems.
Applications: Fragrance solubilizer in personal care; textile lubricants & softeners; metalworking emulsifiers; agricultural adjuvants; pigment dispersants; cosmetic emulsifiers
Storage: Store in sealed containers at ambient temperature. Avoid freezing. Keep away from strong acids.

name: Nonyl Phenol Ethoxylates (NPE)   [Non-ionic Surfactant (Industrial)]
Solubility: Soluble/dispersible in water; soluble in organics
Description: Nonyl Phenol Ethoxylates (NPE) are industrial non-ionic surfactants used as emulsifiers, wetting agents, and detergents in textile, metal, and industrial cleaning applications. Note: restricted for consumer use in EU and many markets due to environmental concerns.
Applications: Industrial textile processing; metalworking emulsifiers; industrial cleaning; agrochemical emulsifiers; emulsion polymerization
Storage: Store in sealed drums at ambient temperature. Restricted for certain consumer applications — check local regulations.

name: Polysorbate 80 (Tween 80)   [Non-ionic Emulsifier (O/W)]
Solubility: Miscible with water
Description: Polysorbate 80 (Tween 80) is a highly hydrophilic non-ionic emulsifier/solubilizer used in food, pharmaceuticals, and cosmetics to produce stable O/W emulsions, solubilize oils and vitamins, and improve bioavailability.
Applications: Food O/W emulsifier (E433); pharmaceutical drug solubilizer & vaccine adjuvant; cosmetic emulsifier; ice cream stabilizer; vitamin E solubilizer
Storage: Store in sealed containers at ambient temperature away from light. Avoid high temperatures.

name: Polysorbate 60 (Tween 60)   [Non-ionic Emulsifier (O/W)]
Solubility: Dispersible/miscible with water
Description: Polysorbate 60 (Tween 60) is a food-grade hydrophilic emulsifier used in baked goods, dairy products, and confectionery to improve texture, volume, and shelf life.
Applications: Food emulsifier (E435) in bakery, cakes, desserts; W/O and O/W emulsions; cosmetic cream emulsifier; pharmaceutical emulsifier
Storage: Store at room temperature away from moisture. May solidify at low temperatures — melt gently before use.

name: Polysorbate 20 (Tween 20)   [Non-ionic Emulsifier / Solubilizer]
Solubility: Miscible with water (HLB 16.7)
Description: Polysorbate 20 (Tween 20) is the most hydrophilic of the Tween series, used as a solubilizer for fragrance oils, essential oils, and vitamins in aqueous formulations, and as a wetting agent in diagnostics.
Applications: Fragrance/essential oil solubilizer; cosmetic toner & mist formulations; pharmaceutical solubilizer; laboratory reagent (ELISA, protein stabilizer); food emulsifier (E432)
Storage: Store in sealed containers at ambient temperature. Very hygroscopic — keep sealed.

name: Acid Thickener (Carbopol-type / HASE thickener)   [Rheology Modifier / Thickener]
Chemical Formula: Crosslinked polyacrylic acid / Hydrophobically modified acrylic copolymer
Appearance: White, fine powder (dry); clear gel on neutralization
Solubility: Swells in water; fully gels on neutralization with alkali
Description: Acid Thickeners (crosslinked polyacrylic acid polymers) are rheology modifiers that form highly efficient thickeners for surfactant systems, cosmetics, and household cleaners after neutralization.
Applications: Shampoo and shower gel thickener; liquid detergent viscosifier; hand sanitizer gel base; cosmetic gel/lotion thickener; industrial cleaner thickener
Storage: Store in sealed bags away from moisture. Powder is a mild dust hazard — use respiratory protection.

name: Piroctone Olamine   [Anti-Dandruff Active / Biocide]
Solubility: 1% in water; freely soluble in ethanol and polar solvents
Description: Piroctone Olamine (Octopirox) is a broad-spectrum antifungal agent and anti-dandruff active effective against Malassezia furfur. It is milder than zinc pyrithione and compatible with most cosmetic formulations.
Applications: Anti-dandruff shampoos; anti-fungal cosmetics; scalp treatments; face wash (acne treatment); textile antimicrobial finish
Storage: Store in sealed containers in a dry, cool place away from light. Stable under recommended storage conditions.

name: Triclosan   [Antimicrobial / Preservative]
Solubility: Very slightly soluble in water (10 mg/L); soluble in ethanol, propylene glycol
Description: Triclosan is a broad-spectrum antibacterial and antifungal compound used in personal care products, industrial antimicrobials, and textiles. Note: usage in rinse-off consumer products is restricted in many markets.
Applications: Antibacterial soap & hand wash (industrial/regulated markets); toothpaste (antiplaque); medical/surgical hand scrub; textile antimicrobial treatment; industrial disinfection
Storage: Store in sealed containers away from light and heat. Follow local regulations for use and disposal.

name: Propyl Paraben   [Cosmetic / Pharmaceutical Preservative]
Solubility: 0.05 g/100 mL (water); freely soluble in ethanol
Description: Propyl Paraben (propyl 4-hydroxybenzoate) is a widely used antimicrobial preservative in cosmetics, pharmaceuticals, and food (E216), effective against moulds and yeasts at low concentrations.
Applications: Cosmetic preservative (creams, lotions, shampoos); pharmaceutical preservative (oral & topical); food preservative (E216); personal care formulations
Storage: Store in sealed containers in a dry, cool place. Stable under normal conditions.

name: PROMIX (Methylisothiazolinone / Methylchloroisothiazolinone blend)   [Biocide / Preservative]
Appearance: Clear to light amber aqueous solution
Solubility: Fully miscible with water
Description: PROMIX (CMIT/MIT blend) is a highly effective broad-spectrum biocide preservative used in industrial water treatment, paints, metalworking fluids, personal care, and household products.
Applications: Industrial water treatment biocide; paint & coating preservative (in-can); metalworking fluid preservative; adhesive & sealant preservative; cosmetic preservative
Storage: Store in sealed containers at ambient temperature. Oxidizing agent — keep away from combustibles. Full PPE required.

name: Polyethylene Glycol (PEG)   [Humectant / Solubilizer / Industrial Lubricant]
Appearance: Clear liquid (low MW) to white waxy solid (high MW)
Solubility: Freely miscible with water
Description: Polyethylene Glycol (PEG) is a versatile polyether alcohol available in a wide range of molecular weights (PEG 200 to PEG 8000), used as a humectant, solubilizer, lubricant, and binder across cosmetics, pharma, food, and industry.
Applications: Cosmetic humectant & emollient; pharmaceutical excipient; food additive (E1521); metalworking lubricant; paper softener; chemical intermediate (surfactant synthesis)
Storage: Store in sealed containers at ambient temperature. Higher MW grades: protect from moisture.

name: Para Chloro Meta Xylenol (PCMX)   [Antiseptic / Antimicrobial]
Solubility: 0.3 g/100 mL (water); freely soluble in ethanol and propylene glycol
Description: Para Chloro Meta Xylenol (PCMX / Chloroxylenol) is an antimicrobial phenolic compound used in disinfectant formulations, antiseptic skin care, veterinary products, and as a preservative in cosmetics.
Applications: Antiseptic hand wash & wound care; household disinfectants & liquid antiseptic; veterinary formulations; industrial disinfection; cosmetic preservative
Storage: Store in sealed containers away from light and heat. Mild irritant — use PPE.

name: Octyl Methoxy Cinnamate (OMC)   [UV Filter / Sunscreen Active]
Appearance: Clear, pale yellow to yellow oily liquid
Solubility: Insoluble in water; soluble in oils and organic solvents
Description: Octyl Methoxy Cinnamate (Ethylhexyl Methoxycinnamate) is the most widely used UVB sunscreen filter (absorbs 280–320 nm), incorporated in sunscreen lotions, day creams, and UV-protective cosmetics.
Applications: Sunscreen (SPF contributor); UV-protective day creams & moisturizers; hair UV protection products; lip balms; combined with UVA filters in broad-spectrum sunscreens
Storage: Store in sealed drums away from light. May absorb UV — protect from prolonged light exposure during storage.

name: Methyl Paraben   [Cosmetic / Pharmaceutical Preservative]
Solubility: 0.25 g/100 mL (water); freely soluble in ethanol
Description: Methyl Paraben (methyl 4-hydroxybenzoate) is the most widely used paraben preservative in cosmetics, pharmaceuticals, and food (E218), providing effective antibacterial and antifungal protection at low use levels.
Applications: Cosmetic preservative; pharmaceutical preservative; food preservative (E218); personal care and household product preservation
Storage: Store in sealed bags in cool, dry place. Stable under normal storage conditions.

name: Lauryl Amine Oxide (LAO)   [Amphoteric Surfactant / Foam Booster]
Appearance: Clear to slightly yellow liquid (30% solution)
Solubility: Fully miscible with water
Description: Lauryl Amine Oxide (LAO) is an amphoteric surfactant that functions as an efficient foam booster and viscosity builder in combination with anionic surfactants. It is mild, biodegradable, and compatible with most surfactant systems.
Applications: Shampoo & dishwash foam booster; liquid detergent viscosity builder; household & institutional cleaning; mild baby product formulations; foam fire-fighting concentrates
Storage: Store in sealed containers at 10–35°C. Avoid freezing.

name: Glyceryl Monostearate (GMS)   [Food Emulsifier / Cosmetic Emulsifier]
Solubility: Insoluble in water; dispersible in hot water; soluble in oils
Description: Glyceryl Monostearate (GMS) is a versatile food emulsifier (E471) and cosmetic self-emulsifying wax. It improves texture, shelf life, and emulsification in bakery, dairy, personal care, and pharmaceutical products.
Applications: Food emulsifier (E471) in bakery, margarine, ice cream; cosmetic O/W emulsifier (self-emulsifying grade); pharmaceutical excipient; PVC lubricant & anti-static agent
Storage: Store in cool, dry, sealed containers below 30°C. Protect from moisture and contamination.

name: Enzymes (Industrial)   [Biological Catalyst / Detergent Additive]
Appearance: Beige to brown granular powder or liquid
Solubility: Soluble/dispersible in water
Description: Industrial Enzymes (proteases, amylases, lipases, cellulases) are biological catalysts used in detergent formulations to break down stains (protein, starch, fat, cellulose), in food processing, textile, and pharmaceutical applications.
Applications: Laundry & dish detergent stain removal; food & beverage processing; textile desizing; leather processing; pharmaceutical manufacturing; biofuel production
Storage: Store at 0–10°C for liquid enzymes; cool/dry for powder grades. Avoid heat and UV exposure. Short shelf life — use before expiry.

name: DMDM Hydantoin   [Formaldehyde-releasing Cosmetic Preservative]
Appearance: Clear, colourless to pale yellow liquid
Solubility: Fully miscible with water
Description: DMDM Hydantoin is a formaldehyde-releasing preservative used in personal care products to control microbial growth. It slowly releases formaldehyde to inhibit bacteria and fungi. Use requires cautious formulation and compliance with local regulations.
Applications: Cosmetic preservative (shampoo, conditioner, lotion); hair care products; industrial water treatment biocide
Storage: Store in sealed containers at ambient temperature. Contains formaldehyde — follow SDS and regulatory guidelines.

name: Cetyl Trimethyl Ammonium Chloride (CTAC)   [Cationic Surfactant / Hair Conditioner]
Appearance: White paste or viscous liquid (30% solution)
Solubility: Soluble in water and ethanol
Description: Cetyl Trimethyl Ammonium Chloride (CTAC) is a cationic quaternary ammonium compound used as a primary hair conditioning agent, fabric softener, and biocide.
Applications: Hair conditioner & rinse (primary conditioning agent); fabric softener; anti-static agent; hair dye vehicle; pharmaceutical excipient; biocide/disinfectant
Storage: Store at 15–30°C. Avoid freezing. Keep away from anionic surfactants to prevent incompatibility.

name: Cocodiethanolamide (CDEA)   [Non-ionic Foam Booster / Viscosifier]
Solubility: Dispersible/miscible in water; soluble in surfactant systems
Description: Cocodiethanolamide (CDEA / Cocamide DEA) is a non-ionic surfactant derived from coconut oil and diethanolamine, used as a foam booster, viscosity builder, and emulsifier in shampoos, hand soaps, and dishwashing liquids.
Applications: Shampoo foam booster & thickener; liquid soap & dishwash formulations; hand wash viscosifier; household & industrial cleaners; corrosion inhibitor in metalworking fluids
Storage: Store in sealed containers at 15–35°C. Avoid freezing. Keep away from strong acids.

name: Carbomer (Carbopol)   [Rheology Modifier / Gelling Agent]
Solubility: Swells in water; forms clear gel on neutralization with alkali
Purity / Grade: Active polymer content per grade specification
Description: Carbomers (Carbopol) are high molecular weight crosslinked polyacrylic acid polymers that swell and thicken dramatically in water upon neutralization with alkali, forming clear, stable gels used across cosmetics, pharmaceuticals, and personal care.
Applications: Cosmetic gel base (hand sanitizer, hair gel, face gel); pharmaceutical topical gel formulations; eye care gels; oral care; suspension stabilizer in HPC systems
Storage: Store in sealed bags in dry conditions. Fine powder — avoid dust inhalation. Neutralize before use with NaOH, TEA, or KOH.

name: Benzophenone-4 (BP-4)   [UV Filter / Sunscreen Active]
Solubility: Slightly soluble in water; soluble in ethanol and propylene glycol
Description: Benzophenone-4 (Sulisobenzone) is a water-soluble UVA+UVB sunscreen filter used in cosmetic and personal care products to protect against UV radiation. It is particularly useful in water-based formulations where oil-soluble UV filters are difficult to incorporate.
Applications: Sunscreen formulations; hair UV protection sprays; UV-protective skin care; combined UV protection systems; photostabilizer for other UV actives
Storage: Store in sealed bags in cool, dry place away from light.

name: Benzophenone-3 (Oxybenzone)   [UV Filter / Sunscreen Active (UVA+UVB)]
Appearance: White to pale yellow crystalline powder
Solubility: Insoluble in water; soluble in oils and ethanol
Description: Benzophenone-3 (Oxybenzone) is a widely used organic sunscreen ingredient that absorbs both UVA (320–400 nm) and UVB (280–320 nm) radiation. Restricted in some markets due to potential endocrine disruption concerns.
Applications: Sunscreen lotions & creams; SPF moisturizers; lip balms with UV protection; hair sunscreen sprays; combined UV filter systems
Storage: Store in sealed bags in cool, dry place away from heat and light.

name: Benzalkonium Chloride (BKC)   [Cationic Biocide / Disinfectant / Preservative]
Appearance: White to off-white powder or colourless liquid (50% solution)
Solubility: Freely soluble in water and ethanol
Description: Benzalkonium Chloride (BKC) is a cationic quaternary ammonium biocide with broad-spectrum antimicrobial activity against bacteria, fungi, algae, and some viruses. It is used as a disinfectant, preservative, and antiseptic across multiple industries.
Applications: Disinfectant hand rubs & hospital antiseptic; swimming pool algicide; cosmetic/personal care preservative; food-contact surface sanitizer; water treatment biocide; nasal drops preservative
Storage: Store in sealed containers at ambient temperature. Incompatible with anionic surfactants. Corrosive at high concentrations.

name: Butylated Hydroxytoluene (BHT)   [Antioxidant / Preservative]
Solubility: Insoluble in water; soluble in oils, ethanol, and acetone
Description: Butylated Hydroxytoluene (BHT) is a phenolic antioxidant used to prevent oxidative rancidity in food, cosmetics, petroleum products, and rubber. It is one of the most widely used synthetic antioxidants globally.
Applications: Food antioxidant (E321) in fats/oils, snack foods; cosmetic antioxidant (in lipsticks, creams); petroleum & lubricant stabilizer; rubber antioxidant; packaging (migration into food products)
Storage: Store in sealed containers away from heat and oxidizing agents. Combustible solid — avoid ignition sources.

name: Calcium Hypochlorite   [Disinfectant / Sanitizer / Bleaching Agent]
Solubility: 21 g/100 mL (20°C) in water
Description: Calcium Hypochlorite is a powerful chlorine-based disinfectant, bleaching agent, and sanitizer used in drinking water treatment, swimming pools, food industry sanitation, and household bleach preparation.
Applications: Swimming pool disinfection; drinking water treatment; food industry CIP sanitation; hospital/institutional disinfection; laundry bleaching; algae control in irrigation
Storage: Strong oxidizer — store away from flammables, organics, and reducing agents. Store in cool, dry, ventilated, acid-free conditions. Avoid moisture.

name: Formaldehyde   [Chemical Intermediate / Biocide / Fixative]
Appearance: Clear, colourless liquid (37–40% aqueous solution / formalin)
Solubility: Infinitely miscible with water
Description: Formaldehyde (formalin solution) is a fundamental chemical intermediate and biocide used in resin synthesis (urea-formaldehyde, phenol-formaldehyde), tissue fixation, leather tanning, and as an industrial disinfectant.
Applications: Urea/phenol formaldehyde resin production; tissue fixative/embalming; leather & textile finishing; industrial biocide/disinfectant; explosive & pharmaceuticals intermediate
Storage: Store in sealed containers at 15–25°C away from heat, acids, alkalis. Highly toxic and flammable vapour — full PPE essential. Regulatory controls apply.

name: Bleaching Earth (Activated Clay / Fuller's Earth)   [Adsorbent / Bleaching Agent]
Appearance: Off-white to light tan fine powder
Solubility: Insoluble in water
Purity / Grade: Bleaching activity per specification (oil decolorization capacity)
Description: Bleaching Earth (activated montmorillonite clay) is used to decolorize and purify vegetable oils, mineral oils, and animal fats by adsorbing pigments, peroxides, soaps, and heavy metals. It is essential in edible oil refining.
Applications: Edible oil refining & decolorization (palm, soy, sunflower oils); mineral oil bleaching; biodiesel production; wax bleaching; water treatment (dye adsorption)
Storage: Store in sealed bags in dry, cool conditions. Avoid moisture — degrades bleaching capacity. Non-hazardous under normal handling.

name: Phosphoric Acid   [Inorganic Acid / Food Additive]
Appearance: Clear, colourless to slightly yellow viscous liquid or crystalline solid
Solubility: Miscible with water in all proportions
Packaging: 35 kg carboys / 250 kg HDPE drums / ISO tanks
Description: Phosphoric Acid is a moderate-strength mineral acid widely used as an acidity regulator in food & beverages (E338), metal treatment (rust conversion), fertilizer production, and as a chemical intermediate for phosphates.
Applications: Food & beverage acidulant (E338) — cola drinks; metal rust treatment & phosphatizing; fertilizer (triple superphosphate) production; pharmaceutical excipient; dental etchant
Storage: Store in acid-resistant sealed containers. Corrosive — avoid skin/eye contact. Keep away from alkalis and strong oxidizers.

name: Maize Starch   [Food Ingredient / Industrial Binder]
Solubility: Insoluble in cold water; gelatinizes in hot water
Description: Maize (Corn) Starch is a natural carbohydrate polymer used as a food thickener, industrial binder, and paper coating agent. It is also a key feedstock for glucose, dextrose, and bioethanol production.
Applications: Food thickener & texturizer; paper & board surface sizing; textile sizing; pharmaceutical binder/filler; adhesives; feedstock for glucose/dextrose production
Storage: Store in cool, dry, sealed bags away from moisture. Protect from insects and rodents. Non-hazardous.

name: Liquid Glucose (Corn Syrup)   [Food Sweetener / Industrial Binder]
Appearance: Clear to slightly yellow viscous liquid
Solubility: Fully miscible with water
Description: Liquid Glucose is a viscous sugar syrup obtained by enzymatic or acid hydrolysis of starch. It is used in confectionery, baking, and brewing as a sweetener and humectant, and in industrial applications as a binder and fermentation substrate.
Applications: Confectionery (candy, toffee, fondant); bakery (moisture retention); brewery & fermentation; pharmaceutical syrup base; adhesives & paper coating; tobacco humectant
Storage: Store in sealed containers at ambient temperature away from strong acids, alkalis, and fermentation conditions.

name: Talc   [Filler / Lubricant / Cosmetic Ingredient]
Appearance: White to grey-white fine, greasy-feeling powder
Solubility: Insoluble in water and organic solvents
Description: Talc is a soft, hydrophobic mineral (mohs hardness 1) used as a filler, lubricant, and extender in plastics, paper, paint, rubber, cosmetics, and pharmaceutical tablets.
Applications: Cosmetic (face powder, body powder, talcum powder); plastic & rubber filler (polypropylene, PVC); paper filler & coating; paint extender; pharmaceutical tablet lubricant; ceramic raw material
Storage: Store in sealed bags in dry conditions. Fine particle grades — use respiratory protection. Ensure asbestos-free certification for human-contact applications.

name: Kaolin (China Clay)   [Filler / Pigment Extender / Industrial Mineral]
Solubility: Insoluble in water
Description: Kaolin (China Clay) is a soft, white aluminosilicate mineral used as an extender/filler in paper, paints, plastics, ceramics, and rubber, and as an active ingredient in antidiarrheal pharmaceuticals.
Applications: Paper coating & filling; paint pigment extender; ceramic raw material; rubber/plastic filler; pharmaceutical antidiarrheal; cosmetic ingredient; pesticide carrier
Storage: Store in sealed bags in dry conditions. Non-hazardous under normal handling.

name: Petroleum Jelly (Petrolatum)   [Emollient / Cosmetic / Industrial Lubricant]
Chemical Formula: Complex mixture of refined mineral waxes and oils
Appearance: White to pale yellow translucent semi-solid
Solubility: Insoluble in water; soluble in chloroform, benzene, and other non-polar solvents
Description: Petroleum Jelly (Petrolatum, Vaseline) is a refined mixture of semi-solid hydrocarbons used as a skin protectant, emollient, lubricant, and corrosion inhibitor across cosmetics, pharmaceuticals, and industry.
Applications: Cosmetic & pharmaceutical emollient/moisturizer; baby care (diaper rash); wound care/healing ointment; industrial lubricant & rust preventive; electrical insulator; cosmetics base
Storage: Store in sealed containers at ambient temperature. Keep away from open flame — combustible at elevated temperatures.

name: White Mineral Oil (Liquid Paraffin)   [Cosmetic / Food / Pharmaceutical / Industrial Lubricant]
Solubility: Insoluble in water; miscible with most non-polar solvents
Purity / Grade: Meets USP/BP specifications (pharmaceutical grade); food grade (FDA/EC compliant)
Description: White Mineral Oil (Liquid Paraffin) is a highly refined, colourless, tasteless, and odourless mineral oil used as a laxative, emollient, food lubricant (food-contact machinery), and base oil in cosmetics and pharmaceuticals.
Applications: Pharmaceutical laxative (oral); cosmetic emollient & skin moisturizer; food-contact machinery lubricant (H1 grade); animal feed supplement; personal care formulations; release agent in food processing
Storage: Store in sealed containers away from heat sources. Chemically inert under normal storage conditions.

name: Toluene Diisocyanate (TDI)   [Polyurethane Raw Material / Isocyanate]
Appearance: Colourless to pale yellow fuming liquid
Solubility: Reacts with water; miscible with organic solvents
Description: Toluene Diisocyanate (TDI) is a key raw material for flexible polyurethane foam, coatings, adhesives, and sealants. It reacts with polyols to form polyurethane polymers with controlled properties.
Applications: Flexible polyurethane foam (furniture, mattresses, automotive seating); polyurethane coatings; adhesives & sealants; elastomers; binders (foundry sand)
Storage: Moisture-sensitive — store in sealed, dry containers. Highly toxic respiratory hazard — full respiratory PPE required. Reacts vigorously with water, alkalis, and alcohols.

name: Soap Noodles   [Soap Raw Material]
Chemical Formula: Sodium soap of fatty acids (C12–C18 saturated & unsaturated)
Solubility: Dispersible/emulsifiable in hot water
Purity / Grade: Total fatty matter (TFM): 76–80% (76 TFM) or 80% (80 TFM)
Description: Soap Noodles are semi-processed soap base pellets produced by saponification of palm/coconut oil blends with caustic soda. They are the primary raw material for bar soap manufacturing worldwide.
Applications: Bar soap manufacturing (bath soap, laundry soap); toilet soap; medicated soap; hotel amenity soap; glycerin-based transparent soap
Storage: Store in cool, dry area away from direct sunlight. Protect from moisture. Non-hazardous under normal handling.

name: Methylene Chloride (DCM)   [Chlorinated Solvent]
Flash Point: Non-flammable (but forms explosive vapour-air mixtures above 25°C)
Solubility: 20 g/L (20°C) in water; miscible with most organic solvents
Description: Methylene Chloride (Dichloromethane, DCM) is a fast-evaporating chlorinated solvent widely used as a paint and varnish stripper, extraction solvent in pharmaceuticals and food processing, and solvent for adhesives and coatings.
Applications: Paint & coating stripper; pharmaceutical extraction (caffeine, APIs); foam blowing agent; adhesive & sealant solvent; aerosol propellant; metal degreasing
Storage: Store in sealed containers away from heat. Non-flammable but vapours can displace oxygen in confined spaces. Use respiratory protection. Suspected carcinogen — follow local regulations.

name: Dextrose Monohydrate   [Food / Pharmaceutical / Fermentation Ingredient]
Solubility: 91 g/100 mL (20°C) in water
Description: Dextrose Monohydrate (glucose monohydrate) is the crystalline form of D-glucose widely used in food production, intravenous pharmaceutical solutions, fermentation media, and as a sweetener and energy source.
Applications: Food sweetener, energy drink ingredient; pharmaceutical IV glucose solution; fermentation carbon source; bakery (yeast food, browning); sports nutrition; dialysis solution
Storage: Store in sealed bags in cool, dry conditions away from moisture. Non-hazardous under normal conditions.

name: Citric Acid   [Organic Acid / Food Additive / Chelating Agent]
Solubility: 73 g/100 mL (20°C) in water; soluble in ethanol
Description: Citric Acid is the most widely used acidulant and flavouring agent in food and beverages globally, and serves as a pH adjuster, antioxidant synergist, chelating agent, and preservative across food, pharmaceutical, personal care, and industrial applications.
Applications: Food & beverage acidulant (E330); pharmaceutical effervescent tablets & pH adjuster; cosmetic pH modifier & chelating agent; household cleaners & descalers; industrial water treatment; detergent builder
Storage: Store in sealed bags in cool, dry conditions. Hygroscopic — protect from moisture. Non-hazardous under normal handling.

name: Cetostearyl Alcohol (CSA)   [Cosmetic Co-emulsifier / Thickener / Emollient]
Appearance: White waxy solid flakes or granules
Solubility: Insoluble in water; soluble in ethanol and oils
Description: Cetostearyl Alcohol (Cetearyl Alcohol) is a mixture of cetyl and stearyl fatty alcohols widely used as a co-emulsifier, emulsion stabilizer, thickener, and emollient in cosmetics and pharmaceuticals. It improves the feel, texture, and consistency of creams and lotions.
Applications: Cosmetic O/W emulsion thickener & stabilizer; creams, lotions, ointments; hair conditioner (co-conditioning agent); pharmaceutical cream/ointment base; emulsifying wax component
Storage: Store in sealed bags or drums below 30°C. Melts above 55°C — store away from heat sources.
